title: The revue tours north and breaks up in Chicago
summary: The show played St. Louis, Chicago, Indianapolis and Memphis, then folded unpaid at the Grand Theater in Chicago, where the band stayed.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: So, where did you go with this band?
Well we went -- we played St. Louis, Chicago, Indianapolis, Memphis --
And Chicago was where the show ended because no one was getting paid --
Which theater did you play in Chicago?
The Grand, the Grand Theater. And

it broke up right there, we had a fine piano player in there, oh he did very well for himself, I can't remember his name, right now, but he did very well in Chicago, in fact, we broke up there and rather than go back to Nashville, we stayed in Chicago.
I see. Did you play at Birmingham?
No, I didn't go to Alabama --
No because the show was headed north.
Oh, so you didn't go to Atlanta, either.
I didn't go to Atlanta with that -- although I did play in Atlanta --
